CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH latest_subject AS (
  SELECT
    c.subject_id,
    c.subject_code,
    c.subject_number,
    c.subject_title,
    c.department_code,
    c.department_name,
    c.hgn_code,
    c.hgn_desc,
    c.total_units,
    c.academic_year,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subject_id, c.hgn_code ORDER BY c.academic_year DESC) AS rn
  FROM catalog_with_hass c
  WHERE (
    c.subject_code = '17' OR c.subject_id LIKE '17.%' OR c.department_name ILIKE '%Political Science%'
  )
  AND c.hgn_code IS NOT NULL AND c.hgn_code <> ''
),
ps_subjects AS (
  SELECT * FROM latest_subject WHERE rn = 1
),
# enrollments per subject across all terms
subj_enroll AS (
  SELECT e.subject_id, SUM(COALESCE(e.num_enrolled_students,0)) AS total_enrollment
  FROM enrollment_by_subject_term e
  JOIN ps_subjects p ON p.subject_id = e.subject_id
  GROUP BY e.subject_id
),
# degree-granting depts for these subjects
deg_gr_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.department_code
  FROM ps_subjects p
  JOIN departments d ON d.department_code = p.department_code
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(d.is_degree_granting,'N')) = 'Y'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.hgn_code AS hass_attribute,
    ANY_VALUE(p.hgn_desc) AS hass_attribute_desc,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) AS num_unique_subjects,
    AVG(CAST(p.total_units AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_units,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(se.total_enrollment,0)),0) AS total_enrollment,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT department_code) FROM deg_gr_depts) AS num_degree_granting_departments
  FROM ps_subjects p
  LEFT JOIN subj_enroll se ON se.subject_id = p.subject_id
  GROUP BY p.hgn_code
),
label AS (
  SELECT
    a.hass_attribute,
    COALESCE(a2.description_on_form, a2.description_in_bulletin, a.hass_attribute_desc) AS hass_attribute_name,
    a.hass_attribute_desc AS hass_attribute_description,
    a.num_unique_subjects,
    a.avg_units,
    a.total_enrollment,
    a.num_degree_granting_departments,
    -- Proxy for subject code description: Political Science is Course 17
    'Course 17 (Political Science)' AS subject_code_description
  FROM agg a
  LEFT JOIN hass_attribute_dictionary a2 ON UPPER(a2.hass_attribute) = UPPER(a.hass_attribute)
)
SELECT * FROM label
ORDER BY hass_attribute;
